verdict.rationale: Skyvern's browser-sessions docs explicitly describe saving signed-in state as reusable browser profiles ('Use a profile when you want to sign in once and reuse that later'). They also state that cookies and local storage persist, so later operations pick up where earlier ones stopped. This directly covers skipping the login wall on later runs. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the profile API and lifecycle (creation, expiry, refresh, sharing across agents), and independent or hands-on corroboration that profiles reliably bypass logins.
